## Pixel IMS 5G 1.0.4

- **Beautiful post-update changelogs:** OTA updates now open a versioned liquid-glass What’s New screen. GitHub release notes survive Android’s installer, an embedded fallback covers sideloads, and the changelog can be reopened from About.
- **Premium interface redesign:** Improved typography, spacing, semantic radio-status colors, compact expert controls, glass surfaces, and restrained motion across Pixel display sizes.
- **Perfectly aligned navigation:** Replaced the Material bottom bar with equal-width cells, fixed centered icon slots, and stable label baselines. The app header now includes the by Nirmala signature.
- **Safer mobile-only diagnostics:** Monitor and Field Test temporarily disable Wi-Fi, fail closed if isolation cannot be confirmed, and restore the previous Wi-Fi state when the session ends.
- **Deeper field reports:** Added OS/build identity, operational PLMN, evidence provenance, NR and EN-DC semantics, IMS/callback coverage, readable policy gates, and sanitized root modem deltas.
- **Important Shizuku guidance:** Every Pixel using Shizuku now receives the honest regional 5G limitation notice on stock Pixel OS and supported alternative Pixel operating systems.

Existing installations using `com.nirmala.pixel5gims` can update normally without uninstalling.
